Maps then remains usable, and the trace visibly obtains a 3 hr 25 min Orlando-to-Miami route. Thus the reused premise has no observed harmful bridge to sending Susan the arrival-time text and is merely concurrent with useful navigation. At the last observable step, Messages is still on the New conversation contact list with no recipient, message body, or sent message visible; that independently observable recipient-input loop, rather than the reuse target, leaves the affected predicate unsatisfied.

summary: The frozen reuse target repeats a false description of the launcher suggestions but causes no visible local harm: skipping Maps sign-in leads to a visible 3 hr 25 min route. The requested text remains visibly unsent because later independent navigation and recipient-entry loops never reach message composition.
